label: Hidden-history obstruction and history-sensitive audit control (inference)
rule: Instantiate the adaptive theorem, reuse CorrectionCriterion.characterization, and evaluate the audit operation
meaning: The blind transition preserves equality of current readouts under either action; the adaptive theorem then supplies equal complete finite transcripts for the selected opposite-marker states. CorrectionCriterion.characterization turns that mismatch in correctness on an equal-data fiber into failure of exact classification. Direct evaluation verifies changing readouts under repeated toggles and shows the supplied history-sensitive audit recovers the marker after one step. The no-coupling assumption is exposed and removed in the positive control. No metaphysical possibility, source attribution, probabilistic estimate, infallibility norm or root-premise discharge is asserted.
